purpose_zh: 把「意见—修改—未采纳理由」写成可带走、可核对的固定格式。回执的作用不是记录已经做了什么，而是让提出意见的人能够查到自己那一条的结论；没有结论的意见视同该点位本轮未通过复核。
purpose_en: A fixed, portable format for the opinion-change-refusal record. A receipt does not exist to log what was done; it exists so that whoever raised a point can look up the ruling on that point. An opinion left without a ruling counts as a node failing that round of review.
issuance_rule_zh: 真实共创启动后，每轮 G3 独立复核结束时发布一批回执，同时张贴于对应点位并进入公开复盘记录。这是机制设计，尚未运行过任何一轮。
issuance_rule_en: Once real co-design begins, a batch of receipts is published at the close of every G3 independent review, posted at the node concerned and entered into the public debrief record. This is mechanism design; no round has yet been run.

required_fields.desc_zh: 回执编号，唯一且可引用
对应的 G3 复核轮次；桌面演示填 not_applicable
required_fields.desc_en: the G3 review round; a tabletop demonstration records not_applicable

required_fields.desc_zh: 涉及的点位；跨点位事项填 all
required_fields.desc_en: the node concerned; cross-node matters record all

required_fields.desc_zh: 提出者的角色组与身份披露方式，不记录个人身份信息
required_fields.desc_en: the raiser's role group and disclosure method; no personal identifying data

required_fields.desc_zh: 原始意见，按提出者的表述登记，不改写为结论语言
required_fields.desc_en: the opinion as raised, in the raiser's own framing, not rewritten into conclusion language

required_fields.desc_zh: 复核过程中查到的事实
采纳、部分采纳或不采纳
required_fields.desc_en: adopted, partially adopted, or not adopted

required_fields.desc_zh: 实际改了什么，须列出被修改的文件或条文
required_fields.desc_en: what actually changed, listing the files or clauses modified

required_fields.desc_zh: verdict 非 adopted 时必填；只写理由，不写安抚
required_fields.desc_en: mandatory whenever the verdict is not adopted; reasons only, no consolation

required_fields.desc_zh: 基准版本治理要求每次变更同时提交失败样本登记；登记为空须给出理由
required_fields.desc_en: baseline version governance requires a failed-sample register with every change; an empty register must state why

required_fields.desc_zh: 受影响指标与复算说明；无读数时须写明未产生读数
required_fields.desc_en: affected metrics and their recomputation note; where there is no reading, say so

required_fields.desc_zh: 第三方复核本条结论的具体方法
required_fields.desc_en: how a third party can re-check this ruling
where the receipt is posted and filed

schema.rejection_rule_zh: 只改条文不交证据的修订不予合并；未采纳的意见必须给出理由，理由不得引用尚未存在的授权。
schema.rejection_rule_en: A revision that edits wording without submitting evidence is not merged, and a rejected opinion must carry a reason that does not lean on an authorisation which does not yet exist.

raised_by.role_group: 方案作者自查（桌面配对推演）
raised_by.identity_disclosure: 无参与者，无个人信息；本条意见由推演过程本身提出
raised_by.identity_disclosure_en: no participant and no personal data; the opinion arose from the run itself

opinion.zh: 把 node_schema 中 ai_off_path 的约束放宽，允许填写引导至线上办理一类路径，以便更多点位能够计入服务覆盖。
opinion.en: Relax the ai_off_path constraint in node_schema so that routes such as directing the user to the online service become acceptable, letting more nodes count towards service coverage.

finding.zh: 推演在样例 TT-N2 上确认了两件事。其一，把该约束实现为可执行规则时，样例中引导至线上办理，在小程序内完成同一事项这句被判定为违反等价原则，判定成立。其二，基准原文只把约束写成自然语言例句，没有给出机器可读的拒绝依据，因此任何两个校验实现都可能得到不同结果——这是基准自身的缺口，不是样例的问题。
finding.en: Two things were established on fixture TT-N2. First, once the constraint is implemented as an executable rule, the fixture wording directing the user to the online service to finish the same task inside the mini-program is judged to breach equivalence, and the judgement holds. Second, the baseline states the constraint only as a natural-language example and supplies no machine-readable ground for refusal, so any two checker implementations may disagree. That gap belongs to the baseline, not to the fixture.

change_made.zh: 不放宽约束，改为把约束补齐为可执行形式：在 seb-tabletop-run.js 中以显式的同一系统词表实现拒绝规则，并在代码注释中声明该词表是本工具的解释而非基准条文。同时登记一条 v0.2 待办：在 seb-spec.json 的 node_schema 中增加 constraint_machine_rule 字段，把拒绝依据从注释升格为规范。
change_made.en: The constraint is not relaxed; it is completed into an executable form. seb-tabletop-run.js implements the refusal through an explicit same-system term list, and the code comment states that the list is this tool's interpretation rather than baseline text. A v0.2 item is registered alongside it: add a constraint_machine_rule field to node_schema in seb-spec.json so the ground for refusal rises from comment to specification.

not_adopted_reason.zh: 放宽字段的意见不予采纳。AI 关闭后的路径若仍依赖同一系统，等价性在定义上就不成立，服务等价差这项读数也随之失去意义——它比较的将是同一条路径的两个入口，而不是两条路径。以提高覆盖率为由放宽判据，等于用改判据的方式提高分数，这正是基准存在的目的所要防止的事。
not_adopted_reason.en: The request to relax the field is refused. If the route after AI is switched off still depends on the same system, equivalence fails by definition and the service-equivalence gap loses its meaning, because it would then compare two doors into one route rather than two routes. Loosening the criteria to raise coverage is raising the score by rewriting the test, which is precisely what the baseline exists to prevent.

failed_sample_register.reason_zh: 本次为桌面推演，无真实参与者、无现场测量，因此不存在参与者失败样本可登记。登记为空的理由在此写明，符合基准版本治理中登记为空须给出理由的要求。
failed_sample_register.reason_en: This was a tabletop run with no real participant and no field measurement, so no participant failure sample exists to register. The reason for the empty register is stated here, as baseline version governance requires.
tool_level_failures_registered: level_definitions 的 gate 字段为自由文本（before G0、post-G3 operation），须以正则抽取闸门编号才能与节点比对；L4 映射至 G3 属本工具的推断，基准未定义
denominator_integrity_rule 未界定适用范围，本工具按分母文字是否出现有效样本或成对测试样本来推导，属本工具的解释

affected_metrics.recomputation_zh: 本次变更不产生任何指标数值。ai_off_service_equivalence_gap 在 metrics.json 中保持 unknown，须由伦理化的真实成对测试取得；scenario_exit_path_coverage 仍按文件完整性口径登记，本次变更未增删任何节点，读数与口径均未改变。
affected_metrics.recomputation_en: The change produces no metric value. ai_off_service_equivalence_gap stays unknown in metrics.json and can only come from an ethically run paired test with real participants; scenario_exit_path_coverage remains a file-completeness figure, and since no node was added or removed, neither its reading nor its definition changed.

verification.zh: 任何人可在 visual/assets 目录下执行 node seb-tabletop-run.js 复核本条结论：样例 TT-N2 应被拒绝，理由为 NODE_CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION:ai_off_path；若把该样例的 ai_off_path 改回不依赖同一系统的写法，同一工具应转为通过。
verification.en: Anyone can re-check this ruling by running node seb-tabletop-run.js in the visual/assets directory: fixture TT-N2 should be rejected with the reason NODE_CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION:ai_off_path, and rewriting that fixture's ai_off_path into a route independent of the same system should turn the same tool to accept.

posting: 本回执随方案包公开，位于 visual/assets/seb-change-receipt-sample.json
真实共创启动后，同类回执张贴于对应点位并进入公开复盘记录
receipts.status_note_zh: 本条回执以本次桌面推演自身为对象，是格式与机制的演示，不是任何一轮真实复核的结论，也不代表任何主体已经审议过该意见。
receipts.status_note_en: This receipt takes the tabletop run itself as its subject. It demonstrates the format and the mechanism; it is not the outcome of any real review round and represents deliberation by no body.
